description: The overlay window (M5.1): it listens to the overlay-view event the app sends it and reads the input level with its one command, get_overlay_level (U4). No settings commands (the app ACL manifest in build.rs; default.json grants them to main only) and nothing else from core:. Checked by src/overlay/capability.test.ts and commands::capability_tests, which invoke the commands from an overlay window and expect a refusal.
